evidence.excerpt: HVAC/mini-split work belongs in mechanical permitting; detached-garage/accessory-structure building work is not triggered by equipment installation alone.

evidence.excerpt: Evaporative cooler replacement is mechanical/HVAC equipment work, not roofing or reroof work when roof covering work is not described.

evidence.excerpt: Private sewer lateral repair/relining routes through sewer/plumbing/wastewater permitting; foundation repair is not triggered by the described trenchless liner.

evidence.excerpt: Outdoor/freestanding signs require sign permit submission; illuminated sign work may also require electrical review.

evidence.excerpt: Chicago requires sign permits for signs on a building/business, with limited exemptions; illuminated sign cabinet work is not a tenant improvement by itself.
